But the code continues to line 431 where `igraph_trie_get(&trie, name, &from)` is called on the destroyed trie, causing the use-after-free.

Wait, actually looking at the stack trace more carefully - the crash is at line 431 which is `igraph_trie_get(&trie, name, &from)`.
